text:
Which statement about alloys is correct?
A
Alloys are harder than pure metals because they contain strong intermolecular forces.
B
Brass is an alloy containing mainly copper and tin.
C
The different-sized atoms in an alloy mean that the layers cannot easily slide over each
other.
D
There are no alloys containing carbon because carbon is a non-metal.
